data.title: Coalition: UAV Launched by Terrorist Houthi Militia toward Southern Region Intercepted, Destroyed
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- Official Spokesperson of the Coalition to Restore Legitimacy in Yemen Major General Turki Al-Malki stated that a UAV launched by the terrorist Houthi militia toward the southern region was intercepted and destroyed.
    
    -- SPA
20:00 Local Time 17:00 GMT
0072
